title: Untrusted evidence isolation demo
description: Builds a structured request envelope separating fixed task instructions, the user’s question, and labeled untrusted source text. A conservative pattern scanner adds review flags without deleting source content. A separate tool gate rejects proposals whose provenance is source evidence and accepts only allowlisted trusted-user actions. These structural checks are educational; they do not prove that a language model will resist prompt injection, and the scanner deliberately has false negatives/positives. Trusted provenance must be assigned outside a model or document.
